hints.title: Ascending Index Scan
hints.text: Iterate through the array indices starting from zero.

hints.title: Modulo Comparison
hints.text: Check if the index modulo ten equals the value at that position.

hints.title: First Satisfying Element
hints.text: Return the first satisfying index encountered, or minus one if none match.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Finds the lowest index i such that i % 10 == nums[i].
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive failure, checking indices from 0 guarantees the smallest match.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Early return on first match achieves optimal average and worst-case time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should use zero-indexed traversal and return -1 on exhaustion.
